reply.analysis: beta = 52 is proven: an independent set of size 52 (check passed) meets a linear code M = I + 6A over F_7 of length 52 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), found with 1 code tried. Compute took only 0.427 s, but wall time was 24.338 s, almost all of it LLM time (23.911 s). On accuracy the agent matches the kushagra_agent baseline (exact, field 7), but that baseline took 0.683 s, so the agent was about 35x slower in wall time. It beats the CP-SAT cover (62, unproven), the fractional cover (59.98, unproven) and f2_minrank_sat (lower bound 51 only). CP-SAT alpha confirmed 52 in 90.7 s. One weak point: the hypothesis left params empty. Nothing suspicious.
